cloud_capacity.description: Capacity of the point cloud buffer (should be set to at least the maximum theoretical number of points).

circle_nms_dist_threshold.description: A distance threshold of circle NMS.

iou_nms_search_distance_2d.description: A maximum distance value to search the nearest objects.

iou_nms_threshold.description: A threshold value of NMS using IoU score.

yaw_norm_thresholds.description: An array of distance threshold values of norm of yaw [rad].

world_frame_id.description: A name of frame id where world coordinates system is defined with respect to.

num_past_frames.description: A number of past frames to be considered as same input frame.

max_allowed_processing_time_ms.description: A threshold value for the allowed processing time. If the processing time exceeds this value, it will be considered a warning state. [ms]

max_acceptable_consecutive_delay_ms.description: A threshold value for the error state. If the duration since the last processing timestamp, which ended within max_allowed_processing_time_ms, exceeds this value, it will be considered an error state. [ms]

validation_callback_interval_ms.description: An interval value for a timer callback that checks whether the current state meets the max_acceptable_consecutive_delay_ms condition. [ms]
